promote._source_note: Board 8 is NOT single-repo: it carries cards whose by-ref source is a different repo, so "*" (which DECLARES a single-repo board) would be a false declaration. Naming this repo qualifies every dl_number/pr_number match against the card's own by-ref source, so a colliding ref number cannot promote another repo's card. A ref whose only match is an UNSOURCED card is named and skipped, never moved -- stamp it with `kbcard patch --pr-url`. Census and evidence: card#8423.
